Data structures for shred batches, leader state, bank, microblock, and PoH messages.

# Purpose
This header file defines shared data structures used by several Firedancer tiles in the `disco` path. It declares packet and slot handoff records such as `fd_shred34_t`, `fd_became_leader_t`, `fd_rooted_bank_t`, `fd_completed_bank_t`, `fd_microblock_trailer_t`, `fd_done_packing_t`, and `fd_microblock_bank_trailer_t`. These types carry shred batches, leader state, bank references, slot timing data, transaction order data, and bundle-related configuration between components such as `pack`, `PoH`, `bank`, and `replay`. The file also defines `fd_poh_init_msg_t`, which packages initial Proof of History parameters for setup and synchronization.
